newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - September 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - September 25.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Wednesday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Public Health Agency rejects U.S. charge that Taiwan violates fair trade practice in medical equipment market.
Scores of publicly listed companies being investigated under new regulation since January.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Crackdown on organized crime moves to cable television.
Taiwan protests Panamanian foreign minister's meeting with Chinese counterpart Qian Qichen.
CENTRAL DAILY NEWS - President Li Teng-hui visits troops at offshore islands.
Justice Department probes involvement of organized crimes in newly listed companies.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Taiwan faces U.S. trade sanction over medical equipment row.
Finance Ministry tightens control on "banker's acceptances" issued by foreign banks.
